svg.title: Compression performance: throughput and output size
svg.desc: 9 warmed samples per operation. Bars show median throughput; whiskers show the interquartile range. See the accompanying report for a text table and methodology.

g.text: v24.21.0 · linux/x64 · 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-13700
Warm · serial · 9 samples · median + interquartile range · throughput: higher is better
Zstd: level 3, checksum on, content size off · gzip: runtime defaults
Output % = compressed / original bytes · each throughput column uses its own linear scale
2026-11-26 UTC · synthetic inputs · initialization excluded · see report for scope and raw samples
